prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1042; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck pain and stiffness that began shortly after the event. The reported symptoms are consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Over the course of fifteen visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, passive range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program, which followed a typical progression for cervical strain. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and several other tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical region is known to this provider. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as functional status recovered. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
